beats.text: You're only about three and a half people away from almost anyone.
Facebook measured this in twenty sixteen, across one point six billion users.
Each dot is a person. A line means they're friends.
The old idea was six steps between any two people.
The real average: only three and a half people in between!
Your friend knows someone, who knows someone. That's why

sources: Bhagat, Burke, Diuk, Filiz & Edunov (2016), Three and a half degrees of separation, Facebook Research – about 1.59 billion active users; each person is connected to every other person by an average of 3.57 people in between (USA: 3.46; 2011: 3.74).
Travers & Milgram (1969), An experimental study of the small world problem, Sociometry 32(4) – the origin of the 'six degrees' idea (about 5 intermediaries in completed letter chains).
